title: Zscaler Client Connector: Windows Registry Keys

blocks.text: This article defines the values for the ZNW_State, ZPA_State, ZWS_State, and ZPA_AuthState registry keys. You can navigate to Zscaler Client Connector registry keys by using the following path: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Zscaler\App.

blocks.item: This article is not an exhaustive list of all registry entries created by Zscaler Client Connector.
When a user logs out of Zscaler Client Connector, registry entries are removed.

blocks.text: Use the ZNW_State registry key to determine a device’s Zscaler Client Connector network state. This table lists each possible value and its corresponding definition.

table: Connected to a trusted full-tunnel VPN.
Connected to a split VPN-trusted network.

blocks.text: This table lists possible registry values and corresponding definitions for the registry keys ZPA_State and ZWS_State, which represent the Private Access service state and the Internet & SaaS service state, respectively.

table: Traffic is intercepted by network drivers.
Traffic is intercepted by network drivers.
Traffic is intercepted through a PAC file (local proxy).
A PAC file is enforced on the system.
Disaster Recovery (safe mode) is active. Traffic handling follows the settings configured in App Profiles.

No adapter with a default route is found (might occur during DHCP renewal). Note: Run the ipconfig /all command and verify the lease-obtained timestamp coincides with the exact moment the issue occurs (e.g., Lease Obtained. . . . . . . . . . : Wednesday, 9 February 2022 2:59:42).
A required microservice is not operational.
A captive portal is detected, and the open timeout expires.
Cannot reach the Public Service Edge for Private Access or Internet & SaaS.
The network is connected but Private Access cannot resolve the broker name.
The outbound/inbound connection to itself fails.
The system is at the maximum socket limit.
A network driver (TAP/TUN/LWF) fails to load.
Interception stops temporarily to allow authentication.
Strict enforcement is blocking network access until the user logs in to Zscaler Client Connector.
The Public Service Edge does not accept the authentication credentials.
The user domain doesn’t match the service’s authentication domain.

The service is in a Private Access Untrusted Server Error state. The Private Access connection receives an SSL exception while connecting. This registry key value is applicable only for Private Access.
The device is not registered with Internet & SaaS and the user must register to proceed.

blocks.text: Use the ZPA_AuthState registry key to determine a device’s Private Access authentication status. This table lists each possible value and its corresponding definition.

table: The user has a valid Private Access session. Access proceeds per policy.
There is no valid Private Access session. The user must sign in or reauthenticate.
The device or user is not registered for Private Access and must complete registration or enrollment before authentication.
Zscaler Client Connector does not initiate Private Access.
